query: SELECT university_name, year_founded, rank FROM University WHERE setting = urban OR year_founded < 1820 OR year_founded > 2000 OR  rank <= 3 OR ran > 100 OR total_undergraduate_enrollment < 1800 OR total_undergraduate_enrollment > 6000 OR academic_calendar = 4-1-4-based academic_calendar = quarter-based OR academic_calendar = semester
